note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav files copied from the batch_654 wallace_2026_learn cache; sha256s match the batch_644-656 records). CODE DERIVATION: rec.csv spec maps rec{i}->rec{i} in S1c and S2c, so item IS the source column name (no rename), but S2c is '-' prefixed and rewritten as 8-resp (itemcov_recoded=1), so Step 5b route 9 was run on the resp axis. Live: 3178 rows, 2 items x 1589; cov_study 4 = S1c (796 ids, 1592 rows, itemcov_recoded=0), 7 = S2c (793 ids, 1586 rows, itemcov_recoded=1). ROUTE 9, all 4 study x item count vectors (resp 1..7): S1c rec1 39/36/47/100/178/187/209, rec2 37/38/40/115/148/174/244 source = live exactly; S2c rec1 source 136/167/168/123/65/53/81 -> live 81/53/65/123/168/167/136, rec2 135/169/159/131/65/50/84 -> live 84/50/65/131/159/169/135 (each an exact reversal). DIRECTION: S1c value labels 1='1 - not at all', 2..6 bare digits, 7='7 - very much'; S2c's run 1='1 - very much' ... 7='7 - not at all'. Cross-check on the raw S2c file: recdich ('Would you recommend XYZ Organization to a friend looking for volunteer opportunities?' 1=Yes, 2=No) gives raw rec-mean 2.487 for Yes (n=563) vs 5.572 for No (n=230), so S2c's printed 1 = very much is correct and the recode right; raw rec-mean correlates +0.707 with raw learn-mean in S2c (same 1 = very much anchors) and +0.697 in S1c (both 1 = not at all); growth condition recommends more in both (S1c raw 5.701 growth vs 4.729 fixed on 1 = not at all; S2c raw 2.749 vs 4.041 on 1 = very much). So live resp 1 = not at all, 7 = very much in both studies; option_text ships those anchors with the '1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped (they would be wrong for the recoded S2c rows); 2-6 blank (bare digits in both sources, not padded). Every item's respondents used all 7 levels in both studies. WORDING: the two studies' labels differ in more than the organization named -- S1c asks about a friend in the consulting industry and MCM Consulting, S2c about a friend looking for a volunteer opportunity and XYZ Organization -- so, following the batch_644-656 convention, item_text carries both verbatim variable labels prefixed 'Study S1c (cov_study = 4): ' / 'Study S2c (cov_study = 7): ' joined by ' | ' (prefixes and separator are IRW's; the wording after each prefix is the label verbatim). No instructions or lead-in in either .sav, and the S1c/S2c .sps syntax files mention no rec variable; instructions left blank. Rights: study-authored items about fictitious organizations; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission). Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: Items rec1-2 were worded differently in the two pooled studies (a friend in the consulting industry and MCM Consulting in Study S1c, cov_study = 4; a friend looking for a volunteer opportunity and XYZ Organization in Study S2c, cov_study = 7), so item_text gives both wordings labelled by study; responses are coded 1 = not at all to 7 = very much in both studies, Study S2c having been reverse-recoded from its printed order (itemcov_recoded = 1).
